blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video understanding, particularly with accompanying audio, remains a central challenge in multimodal intelligence. In this report, we introduce \textbf{WeMM-Video}, a family of Chinese-English bilingual omni-modal foundation models spanning 2B, 4B, 9B, and 35B-A3B variants. Centering on joint audio-visual perception and reasoning, WeMM-Video unifies text, image, audio, and video processing within a hybrid-thinking paradigm, seamlessly supporting both a non-thinking instruct mode for fast, direct responses and a thinking mode for explicit step-by-step reasoning. The models are trained on a large-scale multimodal corpus of approximately 1.2 trillion tokens through progressive pre-training and a multi-stage post-training pipeline incorporating multi-teacher OPD, anti-repetition MrDPO, and specialist RL. Evaluated across more than 120 benchmarks, WeMM-Video demonstrates superior performance in omni-modal video understanding and reasoning, while maintaining highly competitive capabilities across general audio, silent video, image, and text tasks. Specifically, in omni-modal video evaluations, our flagship WeMM-Video-35B-A3B establishes a new open-source state of the art, substantially outperforming proprietary models such as Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash and Seed2.0-Mini-0428 while narrowing the gap with the strong Gemini-3.0-Flash, and our compact WeMM-Video-9B surpasses the larger open-source Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct. We publicly release the WeMM-Video family along with our evaluation and reproduction pipeline to foster further research and development in the open-source community.
blocks.zh: 视频理解,特别是随附音频,仍然是多式联运智能中的一项核心挑战。 在本报告中,我们介绍\textbf{WemM-Video},一个由中英双语全方位模式基础模型组成的家族,涵盖2B,4B,9B,35B-A3B等变体. 以联合视听感知和推理为中心,WemM-Video在混合思维范式内统一文字,图像,音频,视频处理,无缝支持非思维指示模式快速,直接回应,以及明确分步推理的思维模式. 通过逐步进行预训和培训后的多阶段培训,对模式进行了约1.2万亿令吉的大规模多式联运培训,其中包括多教师OPD、反重复MRDPO和专家RL。 WeMM-Video通过120多项基准进行了评估,在全方位模式视频理解和推理方面表现优异,同时在一般音频、无声视频、图像和文本任务方面保持高度竞争的能力。 具体来说,在全方位模式视频评价中,我们的旗舰WemM-Video-35B-A3B建立了新的开源状态,在缩小与强双子座-3.0-Flash的差距的同时,大幅超越了Quen3.5-Omni-Flash和Seed2.0-Mini-0428等专有模式,我们的紧凑型WemM-Video-9B超越了更大的开源Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct. 我们公开发布WemM-Video家族,以及我们的评估和复制管道,以促进开放源码社区的进一步研究和开发。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : WeMM-Video can perceive and understand omni-modal videos, perform complex multimodal reasoning, and effectively handle general tasks across audio, image, and text modalities.
blocks.zh: 图1:WemM-Video能够感知和理解全方位模式视频,进行复杂的多式联运推理,并有效处理跨音频,图像,文本模式的一般任务.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video understanding, particularly the unified comprehension of continuous visual scenes and acoustic signals, represents a pivotal frontier in modern multimodal intelligence. Driven by increasingly prevalent real-world scenarios such as short-form video feeds and embodied intelligence, the demand for machines to perceive dynamic audio-visual environments accurately has grown substantially. Building upon rapid advances in large language models (LLMs) [ 33 , 90 , 17 , 3 , 104 , 34 , 102 , 133 ] , the multimodal community has witnessed the rise of capable vision-language models [ 53 , 60 , 112 , 4 , 103 , 2 ] and audio LLMs [ 98 , 16 , 21 , 125 , 57 ] , with pioneering efforts beginning to explore collaborative audio-visual capabilities [ 123 , 18 , 105 , 87 , 31 ] .
blocks.zh: 视频理解,特别是连续视觉场景和声波信号的统一理解,是现代多式联运智能的关键前沿。 在日益普遍的现实世界情景的推动下,例如短式视频输入和包含的智能,对机器准确感知动态视听环境的需求大大增加。 在大语言模型[33,90,17,3,104,34,102,133]快速进步的基础上,多式联运界见证了有能力的视觉语言模型[53,60,112,4,103,2]和音频语言模型[98,16,21,125,57]的崛起,开创性努力开始探索合作视听能力[123,18,105,87,31].

blocks.en: Despite this progress, comprehensively interpreting real-world videos remains a formidable challenge. Beyond recognizing isolated objects, actions, or sounds, an effective model must capture fine-grained temporal dynamics across frames, connect long-range events, and synthesize visual and acoustic cues through deliberate reasoning to grasp both high-level semantics and subtle details. Existing open-source models, however, remain brittle in complex real-world scenarios: they often overlook critical audio-visual details, fail to align acoustic cues with their corresponding visual events, and suffer from cross-modal hallucinations unsupported by video evidence.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,全面解读现实世界的视频仍然是一个巨大的挑战。 除了识别孤立的物体,动作,或声音之外,有效的模型必须捕捉精细的跨帧时间动态,连接长距离事件,并通过深思熟虑的推理来综合视觉和声学提示,以把握高层次的语义和微妙的细节. 然而,在复杂的现实世界情景中,现有的开放源码模型仍然很简陋:它们常常忽略关键的视听细节,无法将声调提示与其相应的视觉事件相配合,并遭受没有视频证据支持的跨模式幻觉。

blocks.en:
To bridge this gap, we introduce and open-source WeMM-Video , a family of Chinese-English bilingual omni-modal foundation models spanning 2B, 4B, 9B, and 35B-A3B variants.
Centering on omni-modal video perception and reasoning, WeMM-Video unifies text, image, audio, and video processing within a hybrid-thinking paradigm, supporting both a non-thinking (instruct) mode for low-latency, direct responses and a thinking mode for extended chain-of-thought reasoning. By generating grounded reasoning traces over both visual-only and audio-visual inputs, the thinking mode effectively mitigates cross-modal hallucinations and substantially boosts performance on complex video tasks. To endow the models with these capabilities, we train WeMM-Video on a curated multimodal corpus comprising approximately 1.2 trillion (T) tokens via progressive pre-training, followed by a three-stage post-training pipeline incorporating multi-teacher on-policy distillation (OPD), anti-repetition multi-round direct preference optimization (MrDPO) [ 95 ] , and specialist reinforcement learning (RL).
Across comprehensive omni-modal video benchmarks, our strongest model, WeMM-Video-35B-A3B, achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance among open-source models of comparable scale and rivals leading proprietary models, including Gemini-3.0-Flash, Seed2.0-Mini-0428 and Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash. WeMM-Video models also maintain strong, well-rounded capabilities across standalone audio, visual-only video, image, and text tasks.
Beyond standard benchmarks, WeMM-Video has been deployed across multiple core video services within WeChat, supporting diverse applications including live-stream commerce, short-form drama analysis, and interactive video scenarios.
Recognizing that standardized evaluation and transparent reproducibility are vital for the open-source community, we release our evaluation and reproduction pipeline alongside the model weights.
We hope the WeMM-Video family can serve as a versatile foundation for community-driven research and real-world applications, pushing the frontiers of open-source omni-modal video understanding.
blocks.zh:
为了弥补这一差距,我们引入并开放源代码WemM-Video,一个由中英双语全方位模式基础模型组成的家族,跨越2B,4B,9B,35B-A3B变体.
WeMM-Video以全模式视频感知和推理为中心,在一个混合思维范式中统一文本,图像,音频和视频处理,支持低相关性的非思维(指令)模式,直接回应和延长思维链推理的思维模式. 通过在视觉和视听投入上产生有根据的推理痕迹,思维模式有效地缓解了跨模式的幻觉,大大促进了复杂视频任务的性能. 为了赋予这些模式这些能力,我们通过逐步进行预训,对WemM-Video进行由大约1.2兆(T)兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆兆
纵观全面全方位模式视频基准,我们最强的模型WEMM-Video-35B-A3B在可比规模的开源模型和竞争对手领先的专有模型中实现最新(SOTA)性能,包括双子座-3.0-Flash,Seed2.0-Mini-0428和Qun3.5-Omni-Flash. WeMM-Video模型还保持了强大,周全的能力,跨越了独立的音频,唯视觉的视频,图像,以及文本任务.
在标准基准之外,WemM-Video已被部署在WeChat内部的多个核心视频服务中,支持多种应用,包括直播流商业,短形式剧情分析,以及互动视频情景.
认识到标准化评价和透明再生产对开放源码社区至关重要,我们与模型权重一起释放我们的评价和复制管道。
我们希望WemM-Video家族能够成为社区推动研究和现实世界应用的多功能基础,推动开放源码全方位视频理解的前沿。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Model architecture of WeMM-Video.
blocks.zh: 图2:WEMM-Video的模型架构.

blocks.en: 2 Model Architecture
blocks.zh: 2 示范建筑

blocks.en:
The overall architecture of WeMM-Video primarily draws upon the design of video-SALMONN 2 [ 95 ] , receiving multimodal inputs comprising text, image, audio, and video, and producing textual outputs autoregressively, as illustrated in Fig. 2 .
WeMM-Video-2B, WeMM-Video-4B, and WeMM-Video-9B are built on Qwen3.5-2B, Qwen3.5-4B, and Qwen3.5-9B [ 81 ] , respectively, while WeMM-Video-35B-A3B is built on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B [ 82 ] . The audio encoders of WeMM-Video models are initialized from Qwen2.5-Omni [ 123 ] .
blocks.zh:
如图2所示,WemM-Video的整体架构主要借鉴了Video-SALMONN 2[95]的设计,接收包括文本、图像、音频和视频在内的多式联运投入,并自动地产生文本产出。
WeMM-Video-2B,WemM-Video-4B和WemM-Video-9B分别以Quen3.5-2B,Quen3.5-4B和Quen3.5-9B[81]为基础建设,而WemM-Video-35B-A3B则以Quen3.6-35B-A3B[82]为基础建设. WeMM-Video模型的音频编码器由Quen2.5-Omni[123]初始化.

blocks.en:
For visual processing, including both static images and dynamic video frames, we retain the native visual encoders and projection mechanisms of the respective backbones, preserving their pretrained image and video understanding capabilities.
To handle continuous acoustic signals, WeMM-Video incorporates a dedicated audio module comprising a Whisper-based audio encoder [ 83 ] and a window-level Q-Former [ 97 ] . The Whisper-based encoder extracts acoustic features from audio inputs sampled at 16,000 Hz and segmented into 30-second chunks. The window-level Q-Former then compresses these features within local temporal windows of 0.1 seconds across all model variants, mapping each window to a single audio token in the LLM input space and yielding 10 audio tokens per second. For video inputs with accompanying audio, visual and audio tokens are interleaved in chronological order, supplemented with explicit textual timestamps to facilitate fine-grained cross-modal temporal alignment.
blocks.zh:
对于视觉处理,包括静态图像和动态视频帧,我们保留了各自主干部的原生视觉编码器和投影机制,保留了它们事先训练的图像和视频理解能力.
为了处理连续的声波信号,WemM-Video加入了一个专用的音频模块,包含一个Whiper基于音频编码器[83]和一个窗口级的Q-Former[97]. 以Whisper为主的编码器从音频输入中提取出声学特征,在1.6万赫兹取样,分解成30秒块. 窗口级的Q-Former然后在所有模型变体的0.1秒局部时间窗口内压缩这些特性,将每个窗口映射到LLM输入空间的单个音频令牌上,每秒产生10个音频令牌. 对于附有音频、视觉和音频符号的视频输入,按时间顺序进行互页,并辅以明确的文字时间戳,以便利精细的跨模式时间调整。

blocks.en: 3 Data
blocks.zh: 3 数据

blocks.en: To establish robust multimodal perception and reasoning, WeMM-Video is trained on a comprehensive, high-capacity training corpus. As shown in Fig. 3(a) , the corpus encompasses about 1.2T tokens. Notably, joint audio-visual data constitutes the largest share, contributing 45.4% of the overall volume, providing dense temporal supervision for modeling complex multimodal dynamics.
blocks.zh: 为了建立强有力的多式联运观念和推理,WemM-Video接受了全面、高能力培训。 如图3(a)所示,人身保护令书包含约1.2T个令牌。 值得注意的是,联合视听数据占最大份额,占总量的45.4%,为模拟复杂的多式联运动态提供了密集的时间监督。

blocks.en: (a) Token distribution by modality.
blocks.zh: (a) 按方式进行托盘分配。

blocks.en: (b) Token distribution by task.
blocks.zh: (b) 按任务进行分配。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Composition of the WeMM-Video training data.
blocks.zh: 图3:WEMM-Video培训数据的组成。

blocks.en: Besides, Fig. 3(b) illustrates the detailed token distribution across tasks. Captioning accounts for the largest task proportion (37.7%) and serves as the bedrock for foundational multimodal perception. Within this category, we place strategic emphasis on two complementary types of video captions: fine-grained visual captions and joint audio-visual captions. First, for fine-grained visual captioning, we curate an action- and event-dense video split spanning competitive sports, esports, gaming, choreography, and outdoor activities, annotated with dense descriptions that capture rapid physical dynamics and subtle temporal state transitions. Second, for audio-visual captioning, we scale up native omni-modal videos such as films, short-form dramas, interviews, variety shows, and live-stream commerce, synthesizing comprehensive captions that jointly describe visual actions, spoken dialogue, and ambient acoustic signals along a continuous timeline. All candidate captioning data undergo a rigorous pipeline of automated quality scoring, semantic deduplication, and toxicity filtering to ensure both perceptual fidelity and data diversity.
blocks.zh: 此外,图3(b)说明了各项任务之间的详细象征性分配。 说明性占最大任务比例(37.7%),是基本多式联运观念的基石。 在这一类别中,我们从战略上强调两种相辅相成的视频字幕:精细的视觉字幕和联合视听字幕。 首先,对于精细的视觉字幕,我们整理一个动作和事件密集的视频,它跨越竞技体育、体育、游戏、舞蹈和户外活动,并附有密集的描述,记录快速的身体动态和微妙的时态过渡。 第二,对于视听字幕,我们推广本土全方位模式的视频,如电影、短片、访谈、品种节目和直播流商业,将综合描述视觉动作的综合字幕、口语对话以及环境音响信号与持续时间同步。 所有候选标题数据都经过严格的管道,包括自动质量评分、语义解析和毒性过滤,以确保知觉忠诚和数据多样性。

blocks.en: Since the base model natively lacks acoustic perception, we incorporate a dedicated audio corpus to construct and align the acoustic representation space. This collection covers large-scale automatic speech recognition (ASR), music understanding, and general audio understanding.
blocks.zh: 由于基础模型本土缺乏声波感知,我们加入了一个专用的声波体来构建和调整声波代表空间. 本集涵盖大规模自动语音识别(ASR),音乐理解,以及一般音频理解.

blocks.en: Beyond standard single-video streams, real-world applications frequently require models to process streaming feeds and multi-video contexts. To enhance generalization over heterogeneous and complex inputs, we construct a dedicated cross-media understanding split, targeting multi-source tasks such as pairwise video comparison, video-soundtrack compatibility analysis, and e-commerce product-to-ad consistency verification.
blocks.zh: 除了标准的单视频流外,现实世界的应用经常需要模型来处理流流反馈和多视频背景. 为加强对不同和复杂投入的概括,我们构建了专门的跨媒体理解分解,以双向视频比较、视频声道兼容性分析、电子商务产品与数据一致性核查等多来源任务为目标。

blocks.en: While perceptual understanding is critical, audio-visual joint reasoning remains a significant bottleneck that existing open-source models rarely address effectively. High-quality knowledge, STEM, and complex reasoning data are indispensable for cultivating these advanced cognitive capabilities; however, verifiable audio-visual reasoning data is naturally scarce in the wild. To bridge this gap, we curate a substantial knowledge and reasoning QA collection via a dual strategy: we incorporate large-scale vision-language STEM and knowledge reasoning datasets augmented with high-quality thinking traces, alongside a curated set of native audio-visual reasoning tasks. This synergy effectively transfers deep reasoning capabilities to omni-modal scenarios while preserving and augmenting the backbone model’s intrinsic problem-solving proficiencies.
blocks.zh: 虽然认知理解至关重要,但视听联合推理仍然是一个重大的瓶颈,而现有的开源模型很少有效处理。 高质量的知识,STEM,和复杂的推理数据对于培养这些先进的认知能力是必不可少的;然而,可核查的视听推理数据在野外自然稀缺. 为了弥补这一差距,我们通过双重战略,整理了大量的知识和推理QA集:我们加入了大规模视觉语言STEM和知识推理数据集,并增加了高质量的思维痕迹,同时完成了一套本地视听推理任务。 这种协同效应有效地将深刻的推理能力转移到了全方位模式的情景中,同时维护和增强骨干模型固有的解决问题的能力。

blocks.en: 4 Training
blocks.zh: 4 培训

blocks.en: The WeMM-Video family is trained through a unified pipeline comprising progressive multimodal pre-training and multi-stage post-training.
blocks.zh: WeMM-Video家族通过一个包括渐进式多式联运预培训和多阶段后培训在内的统一管道接受培训。

blocks.en: 4.1 Pre-training
blocks.zh: 4.1 培训前

blocks.en: The pre-training of WeMM-Video follows a progressive three-stage curriculum that systematically expands the context window while enriching cross-modal representations. This strategy smoothly bridges modality gaps, injects broad omni-modal knowledge, and scales long-horizon contextual comprehension, as outlined below.
blocks.zh: WeMM-Video的预训遵循一个进步的三阶段课程,系统地扩展上下文窗口,同时丰富跨模式表现. 如下文所述,这一战略顺利弥合模式差距,注入广泛的全方位模式知识,并扩展长期背景理解。

blocks.en: The initial stage focuses on bridging the acoustic representation space with the pre-trained backbone under a compact context window. In this stage, only the audio aligner (i.e., the window-level Q-Former) is optimized, while the backbone LLM and modality encoders remain frozen. Training on foundational audio-text pairs equips the model with core auditory perception capabilities, encompassing ASR and general audio captioning.
blocks.zh: 初始阶段的重点是在紧凑的上下文窗口下,用事先训练过的骨干连接声波代表空间. 在这个阶段,只有音频对齐器(即窗口级的Q-Former)被优化,而主干LLM和模式编码器仍然被冻结. 关于基本音频文本对子的培训使模型具有核心听觉能力,包括ASR和一般音频字幕。

blocks.en: With an expanded context window, Stage 2 serves as the core pre-training phase for large-scale omni-modal knowledge injection. Starting from this stage, we unfreeze all model parameters except the visual encoder, as the inherited visual encoder already provides sufficiently strong visual representations. By training on a diverse mixture of textual, visual, auditory, and joint audio-visual data, this stage establishes a unified cross-modal representation space and prepares the model for native omni-modal video comprehension.
blocks.zh: 随着上下文窗口的扩大,第二阶段成为大规模全面模式知识注入的核心培训前阶段。 从这个阶段开始,我们解冻除视觉编码器外的所有模型参数,因为继承的视觉编码器已经提供了足够强大的视觉表现. 通过对文字、视觉、听觉和联合视听数据进行多种组合的培训,这一阶段建立了一个统一的跨模式代表空间,并为本地的全模式视频理解模式做准备。

blocks.en: In the final pre-training stage, we maintain the same trainable parameter configuration as Stage 2 while further scaling the context window to accommodate extended multimodal sequences. Training on lengthy multimodal inputs, such as long-form videos, extended audio recordings, and multi-video scenarios, enhances the model’s capacity to capture long-range temporal dependencies across modalities while preserving robust performance on general downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 在最后的训练前阶段,我们保持与第二阶段相同的可训练参数配置,同时进一步扩大上下文窗口,以适应扩展的多式联运序列。 关于长式录像、扩展录音和多视频假想等冗长的多式联运投入的培训,加强了模型的能力,以掌握不同模式的长期时间依赖性,同时保持对一般下游任务的有力表现。

blocks.en: 4.2 Post-training
blocks.zh: 4.2 培训后

blocks.en: Following large-scale pre-training, the models acquire strong foundational omni-modal capabilities but still face several challenges. First, general language and vision-language capabilities can be further improved, particularly in complex perception and reasoning tasks. Second, generation stability remains a challenge in complex multimodal scenarios, where models may produce excessively long reasoning traces or repetitive outputs. Third, specialized capabilities require further enhancement, especially in challenging tasks such as audio-visual speaker identification, video-soundtrack matching, structured music understanding, and complex audio-visual reasoning. To address these challenges, we develop a progressive three-stage post-training pipeline consisting of multi-teacher OPD, anti-repetition MrDPO, and specialist RL, targeting general capability enhancement, generation stabilization, and specialized capability improvement, respectively.
blocks.zh: 经过大规模的预训,这些模式获得了强大的基本全方位模式能力,但仍面临若干挑战。 第一,一般语言和视觉语言能力可以进一步提高,特别是在复杂的认知和推理任务中. 第二,在复杂的多式联运情景中,世代稳定仍然是一个挑战,因为模型可能产生过长的推理痕迹或重复输出。 三,专业能力需要进一步提高,特别是在视听扬声器识别,视频声道匹配,结构化音乐理解,复杂视听推理等具有挑战性的任务方面. 为了应对这些挑战,我们开发了一个渐进式的三阶段培训后管道,由多教师OPD、反对重复的MRDPO和专家RL组成,分别针对一般能力的增强、发电稳定和专门能力的提高。

blocks.en: We adopt a multi-teacher distillation strategy to enhance general language and vision-language capabilities while preserving omni-modal understanding. Specifically, stronger external teachers provide supervision for text and vision-language tasks to improve general perception and reasoning, while teachers from the same model family are employed to retain existing audio and audio-visual capabilities. We further leverage cross-modal distillation to transfer knowledge from text to audio tasks, enhancing speech understanding and instruction-following. This strategy enables complementary knowledge transfer across modalities while mitigating capability degradation.
blocks.zh: 我们采取了一项多教师提炼战略,以加强一般语言和视觉语言能力,同时保持全方位理解。 具体来说,更强大的外部教师对文字和视觉语言任务进行监督,以改善一般的认知和推理,同时雇用来自同一模范家庭的教师保留现有的视听能力。 我们进一步利用跨模式的提炼,将知识从文本转移到音频任务,加强语音理解和遵循教学。 这项战略有助于在缓解能力退化的同时,通过各种方式进行互补的知识转让。

blocks.en: We observe that the base models have a non-trivial tendency toward repetitive, endless decoding, which persists after pre-training and OPD and hinders subsequent RL training. To address this, we apply MrDPO [ 95 ] to iteratively optimize the model using offline-mined hard-negative samples exhibiting repetitive decoding across video, audio, and vision-language tasks. Compared with online optimization methods, offline mining more efficiently captures these relatively rare degeneration cases. To maintain stability across multiple optimization rounds, we only update LoRA [ 39 ] adapters during each round, merging and reinitializing them between successive rounds.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,基础模型具有重复、无休止的解码的非三角倾向,在预训和OPD之后持续存在,并阻碍随后的RL培训。 为了解决这个问题,我们运用MrDPO[95],利用线下硬阴性样本,迭代优化模型,在视频、音频和视觉语言任务中反复解码。 与在线优化方法相比,离线开采能更有效地捕捉这些相对罕见的退化案例. 为了在多个优化回合间保持稳定性,我们只在每轮期间更新LORA[39]适配器,在连续回合间合并并重新初始化.

blocks.en: In the final stage, we employ reinforcement learning to enhance challenging downstream capabilities. We curate diverse and challenging training instances through offline inference and evaluation, filtering out samples that the model already solves reliably. Depending on task verifiability, we combine rule-based rewards for deterministic tasks with rubric-based and teacher-consistency rewards for open-ended tasks. A dynamic reward router assigns task-specific rewards, while instruct and thinking modes are jointly optimized through stochastic sampling. We further extend RL to long-context training with increased video frame coverage and sequence lengths, enabling the model to better adapt to extended multimodal inputs and maintain generation stability.
blocks.zh: 在最后阶段,我们利用强化学习来加强下游具有挑战性的能力。 我们通过离线推论和评价,过滤模型已经可靠解决的样品,来管理各种具有挑战性的培训案例。 根据任务的可核查性,我们把确定性任务的有章可循的奖励与无限期任务的有章可循的奖励结合起来。 一个动态的奖励路由器分配了任务特定奖励,而指示和思维模式则通过抽查抽样共同优化. 我们进一步将RL扩展为长文本培训,增加视频帧覆盖面和序列长度,使该模型能够更好地适应扩展的多式联运投入并保持生成稳定性。

blocks.en: 5 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5. 评价

blocks.en: We conduct comprehensive evaluations of the WeMM-Video family across four core modalities: video, audio, image, and text, covering all four parameter scales: 2B, 4B, 9B, and 35B-A3B.
blocks.zh: 我们通过视频、音频、图像和文本等四个核心模式对WemM-Video家族进行全面评估,涵盖所有四个参数尺度:2B、4B、9B和35B-A3B。

blocks.en: For omni-modal video understanding, we compare WeMM-Video against leading proprietary models, including Gemini-3.0-Flash (medium thinking), Seed2.0-Mini-0428 (medium thinking), and Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash, alongside open-source omni-modal models such as Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct and MiniCPM-o-4.5-9B. For silent video understanding, we further include Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B as baselines. Across both video evaluation suites, we report both instruct and thinking mode results for WeMM-Video-35B-A3B to provide a direct comparison with non-thinking baselines and highlight reasoning gains, while reporting only the thinking mode for the 2B, 4B, and 9B variants for conciseness.
blocks.zh: 对于全方位模式视频理解,我们比较WemM-Video与领先的专有模式,包括双子座-3.0-Flash(中度思维),Seed2.0-Mini-0428(中度思维),以及Qune3.5-Omni-Flash,与Qune3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instructionct和MiniCPM-o-4.5-9B等开源全方位模式. 对于静音视频理解,我们还将Quen3.5-9B和Quen3.6-35B-A3B作为基线. 在两个视频评价套件中,我们报告WEMM-Video-35B-A3B的指令和思维模式结果,以提供与非思维基线的直接比较,并突出推理成果,同时只报告2B,4B和9B变体的思维模式,以简洁化.

blocks.en: For audio understanding, we compare against Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash, Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct, and MiniCPM-o-4.5-9B, evaluating all WeMM-Video variants in instruct mode given the direct perceptual nature of most standard audio benchmarks. For image and text tasks, we compare against Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash, Qwen3.5-9B, and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, and report thinking mode results across all WeMM-Video variants.
blocks.zh: 为了听觉理解,我们比较了Quen3.5-Omni-Flash,Quen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct,以及MiniCPM-o-4.5-9B,考虑到大多数标准音频基准的直接感知性,在指示模式下评价所有WemM-Video变体. 对于图像和文本任务,我们比较Quen3.5-Omni-Flash,Quen3.5-9B,以及Quen3.6-35B-A3B,并报告所有WemM-Video变体的思维模式结果.

blocks.en: 5.1 Omni-Modal Video Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.1 奥姆尼-莫达尔 视频评价

blocks.en:
Table 1 and Table 2 summarize the performance on joint audio-visual benchmarks. The evaluation is organized around five critical dimensions: general audio-visual understanding, audio-visual hallucination, video-music understanding, audio-visual interaction, and detailed audio-visual captioning. This evaluation suite incorporates 33 representative benchmarks, including Video-MME (with audio) [ 26 ] , Video-MME-v2 (with audio) [ 27 ] , Daily-Omni [ 144 ] , WorldSense [ 36 ] , AVUT Human [ 127 ] , AV-SpeakerBench [ 74 ] , Video-Holmes [ 14 ] , OmniVideoBench [ 48 ] , RivaBench [ 93 ] , LVOmniBench [ 99 ] , FutureOmni [ 11 ] , JointAVBench [ 7 ] , SciVideoBench [ 20 ] , MMOU [ 30 ] , OmniCompass-AV [ 62 ] , EvaOmni [ 41 ] , OmniReasoningBench [ 59 ] ,
AVHBench Judgement [ 94 ] , SVHalluc [ 135 ] , MUSIC-AVQA [ 50 ] , HarmonySet [ 143 ] , Qualcomm IVD [ 79 ] , OmniVChat [ 35 ] , ODU-Bench [ 10 ] , O-IN-Bench [ 122 ] , SocialOmni [ 121 ] ,
Omni-Cloze [ 71 ] , video-SALMONN 2 testset [ 95 ] , UGCVideoCap [ 118 ] , DVD-Bench (En) [ 96 ] , OmniCap-IF [ 109 ] , Caption-Based QA on DailyOmni and WorldSense [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh:
表1和表2概述了联合视听基准的执行情况。 评价围绕五个关键层面进行:一般视听理解、视听幻觉、视频音乐理解、视听互动以及详细的视听字幕。 该评价套装包含33个代表性基准,包括Video-MME(含音频)[26],Video-MME-v2(含音频)[27],Daily-Omni [144],WorldSense [36],AVUT Human [127],AV-Speaker Bench [74],Video-Holmes [14],OmniVideo Bench [48],Riva Bench [93],LVomni Bench [99],FutureOmni [11],联合AV Bench [7],SciVideo Bench [20],MMOU [30],OmniCompass-AV [62],EvaOmni [41],OmniReasoning Bench [59],
AVH Bench案判决书 [94], SVHalluc [135], MUSIC-AVQA [50], HarmonySet [143], Qualcomm IVD [79], OmniVChat [35], ODU-Bench [10], O-IN-Bench [122], SocialOmni [121],
Omni-Cloze [71],视频-SALMONN 2测试集 [95],UGCVideo Cap [118],DVD-Bench (En) [96],OmniCap-IF [109],DailyOmni和WorldSense上的Cap-QA [12].

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 and Table 2 , our flagship model, WeMM-Video-35B-A3B, establishes a new open-source state of the art in omni-modal video understanding, demonstrating dominance among open-source models while holding a clear advantage over proprietary models such as Seed2.0-Mini-0428 and Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash, and approaching Gemini-3.0-Flash. In general audio-visual understanding, WeMM-Video-35B-A3B (Thinking) surpasses Seed2.0-Mini-0428 on 16 out of 17 benchmarks and also outperforms Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash on 16 out of 17 benchmarks. Beyond general comprehension, WeMM-Video-35B-A3B also performs on par with leading proprietary models across specialized dimensions, including audio-visual hallucination, video-music understanding, audio-visual interaction, and audio-visual captioning. Moreover, WeMM-Video stands out among existing open-source models for its strong native omni-modal thinking capability: as evidenced by comparing the instruct and thinking modes of WeMM-Video-35B-A3B, explicit step-by-step reasoning unlocks substantial performance gains across most audio-visual comprehension and complex reasoning tasks.
blocks.zh: 如表1和表2所示,我们的旗舰型号WemM-Video-35B-A3B在全美模式视频理解中建立了新的开源状态,在开源模式中显示出优势,同时拥有明显优势于Seed2.0-Mini-0428和Quen3.5-Omni-Flash等专有模式,并接近双子座-3.0-Flash. 一般来说,WEMM-Video-35B-A3B(思维)在17个基准中超过16个Seed2.0-Mini-0428,在17个基准中也超过了Qune3.5-Omni-Flash。 除了一般理解之外,WEMM-Video-35B-A3B还同专业层面的主要专有模式进行同等的表演,包括视听幻觉、视频音乐理解、视听互动和视听字幕。 此外,WemM-Video在其强大的本土全方位模式思维能力的现有开源模式中占有突出地位:通过比较WemM-Video-35B-A3B的指令模式和思维模式,明确分步推理在大多数视听理解和复杂推理任务中释放出实质性的性能收益。

blocks.en: Across the smaller variants, the WeMM-Video family similarly delivers strong performance. Notably, WeMM-Video-9B (Thinking) outperforms the leading open-source omni-modal models, Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct and MiniCPM-o-4.5-9B, across most general audio-visual understanding and downstream tasks, while WeMM-Video-4B (Thinking) also surpasses the 30B-scale baseline on the vast majority of benchmarks. Even our most compact WeMM-Video-2B model matches or outperforms the 30B-scale baseline on numerous general perception, hallucination, and captioning benchmarks, offering a highly competitive choice for resource-constrained deployments.
blocks.zh: 在整个较小的变体中,WemM-Video家族同样具有强大的性能. 值得注意的是,WEMM-Video-9B(思维)在大多数一般的视听理解和下游任务上都超过了领先的开源全方位模式,Qune3-Omni-30B-A3B-Istruct和MiniCPM-o-4.5-9B,而WEMM-Video-4B(思维)也超过了绝大多数基准的30B级基线. 即使我们最紧凑的WEMM-Video-2B模型也匹配或超过了基于众多一般感知、幻觉和字幕基准的30B级基线,为资源有限的部署提供了高度竞争性的选择。

blocks.en: Table 3 and Table 4 present the evaluation results on silent video benchmarks. We evaluate the models across seven core dimensions: general video understanding, long video understanding, fine-grained perception, temporal grounding, spatial understanding, streaming video understanding, and multi-video understanding. blocks.en: Overall, the WeMM-Video family demonstrates highly competitive performance on silent video understanding without suffering much from the visual degradation often introduced by acoustic modality integration. In particular, WeMM-Video-35B-A3B holds a clear lead over Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash across nearly all benchmarks, while performing on par with its strong vision-language backbone, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, as well as the proprietary Seed2.0-Mini-0428 across evaluated dimensions. Consistent trends are observed across the smaller variants: WeMM-Video-9B and WeMM-Video-4B substantially outperform the open-source omni-modal baselines Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct and MiniCPM-o-4.5-9B, with WeMM-Video-9B matching or surpassing its Qwen3.5-9B backbone on the majority of benchmarks and WeMM-Video-2B delivering competitive results at a compact scale.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,WemM-Video家族在无声视频理解上表现出高度竞争的表现,而不会因声学模式融合常常引入的视觉退化而受苦受难. 尤其是,WEMM-Video-35B-A3B在几乎所有基准上都明显领先于Quend3.5-Omni-Flash,同时与其强大的视觉语言骨干Qwen3.6-35B-A3B以及所有受评价的Seed2.0-Mini-0428。 在较小的变体中观察到了一致的趋势:WemM-Video-9B和WemM-Video-4B大大超过了开源的全方位模式基线Qune3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct and MiniCPM-o-4.5-9B,在大多数基准中,WemM-Video-9B匹配或超过其Quen3.5-9B主干线,WemM-Video-2B在紧凑的规模下提供竞争结果。

blocks.en: Although primarily centered on video understanding, the WeMM-Video family exhibits strong, well-rounded audio capabilities. Notably, WeMM-Video excels in general audio understanding. The 35B-A3B variant surpasses open-source baselines across widely used benchmarks like MMAU-Pro, MMAR, and MMSU, and performs on par with the proprietary Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash. Moreover, benefiting from targeted optimization, WeMM-Video leads on voice interaction and spoken instruction-following benchmarks, while also remaining highly competitive in music understanding as well as speech and lyrics recognition.
blocks.zh: 虽然主要以视频理解为中心,但WemM-Video家族展现出强大,全方位的音频能力. 值得注意的是,WEMM-Video在一般音频理解方面表现优异。 35B-A3B变体超越了MMAU-Pro、MMAR和MMSU等广泛使用的基准的开源基线,与专有的Quen3.5-Omni-Flash相同。 此外,WemM-Video还从有针对性的优化中受益,领导语音互动和口头教学遵循基准,同时在音乐理解以及语音和歌词识别方面也保持高度竞争力。

blocks.en: Overall, the WeMM-Video family effectively preserves the strong image perception and reasoning capabilities of its vision-language backbones from omni-modal training. Specifically, WeMM-Video-35B-A3B and WeMM-Video-9B comprehensively outperform Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash across nearly all evaluated benchmarks, while performing on par with their respective Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Qwen3.5-9B backbones.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,WemM-Video家族通过全方位模式培训,有效地保留了视觉语言骨干强大的形象感知和推理能力. 具体来说,WEMM-Video-35B-A3B和WEMM-Video-9B在几乎所有评价基准上都全面超过了Quen3.5-Omni-Flash,同时与各自的Quen3.6-35B-A3B和Quen3.5-9B骨干业绩相同。

blocks.en: Consistent with the image evaluation findings, incorporating audio-visual modalities into WeMM-Video preserves the core linguistic capabilities of the base models. Across all evaluated dimensions, WeMM-Video-35B-A3B and WeMM-Video-9B substantially outperform Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash, while performing on par with their respective Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Qwen3.5-9B backbones and achieving further improvements in instruction following.
blocks.zh: 与图像评价结论一致,将视听模式纳入WemM-Video保留了基础模型的核心语言能力. 在所有评价的维度中,WEMM-Video-35B-A3B和WEMM-Video-9B的性能都大大超过Quen3.5-Omni-Flash,同时与各自的Quen3.6-35B-A3B和Quen3.5-9B骨干实现同等效果,并在随后的教学中实现进一步改进。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this report, we present WeMM-Video, a family of Chinese-English bilingual omni-modal foundation models spanning 2B, 4B, 9B, and 35B-A3B parameter scales. Centered on omni-modal video understanding and reasoning, WeMM-Video unifies text, image, audio, and video processing within a hybrid-thinking paradigm through progressive three-stage pre-training and a multi-stage post-training pipeline comprising multi-teacher OPD, anti-repetition MrDPO, and specialist RL. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that our flagship WeMM-Video-35B-A3B establishes a new open-source state of the art in omni-modal video understanding and rivals leading proprietary models, while our lightweight variants exhibit strong cross-scale efficiency. Beyond joint audio-visual comprehension, the WeMM-Video family also delivers leading performance across audio, silent video, image, and text modalities. We publicly release the model weights along with the complete evaluation and reproduction pipeline, and we hope WeMM-Video will serve as a solid foundation for future research and real-world omni-modal applications.
blocks.zh: 在本报告中,我们介绍了WemM-Video,这是一个由中英双语全方位模式基础模型组成的家族,跨越2B,4B,9B,35B-A3B参数尺度. WeMM-Video以全模式视频理解和推理为中心,通过渐进的三阶段前培训和由多教师OPD、反重复MRDPO和专家RL组成的多阶段培训后管道,在一个混合思维范式中统一文本、图像、音频和视频处理。 综合评价显示,我们的旗舰WEMM-Video-35B-A3B在全方位模式视频理解方面建立了一种新的开源状态,竞争对手是领先的专有模式,而我们的轻量级变体则表现出强大的跨尺度效率. 除了共同的视听理解外,WemM-Video家族还提供各种音频、无声视频、图像和文本模式的主要表演。 我们公开发布模型权重以及完整的评价和复制管道,我们希望WemM-Video将成为未来研究和现实世界的全方位模型应用的坚实基础.
